description:
Implement the reusable technical foundation for the new graph workspace after the contract research is settled.

This work should:
- extract, parameterize, or otherwise cleanly adapt the prompt-manager graph primitives where reuse is actually warranted
- avoid copy-pasting prompt-manager-specific node/edge assumptions into swarm-manager
- add swarm-manager graph data services/contracts for captures, backlog items, initiatives, scenarios, and runs
- formalize typed edges such as depends_on, initiative membership, scenario impact, capture-to-item lineage, and backlog-to-run relationships
- expose agent-manager deep links and run metadata needed by the inspector
- formalize how scenario impact is computed from acceptance allow/deny patterns instead of leaving it as scattered UI-only logic
- handle graph filtering, clustering, and node-count guardrails needed for a professional large-graph UX

This is the foundation item that makes the rest of the redesign possible. Keep it greenfield and type-safe rather than layering compatibility shims on the old tabbed surfaces.
name: swarm-manager-graph-data-foundation
title: Build Swarm Manager Graph Data Foundation
